svg.title: Staple — the market-memory mark
svg.desc: It is worth what it is worth. A balance, hanging level. Nothing on either pan, nothing tipping it - which is the whole of what this model says. It is the only mark in the set that is symmetrical, and that is doing the work: the other three are all lopsided, because the other three all lean one way. Generated by tools/build-icons.mjs from data/pricing.json and data/components.json - do not edit. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.
